name: Cala Beach Resort
positioning: Pyramid-shaped beach resort between the pinewood and the beach at Punta Ala, on the Tuscan coast of Maremma
best_for: Travelers who want a Tuscan beach stay with private cabanas and beachfront dining
Couples looking for sea-view suites and a candlelit dinner on the sand

facts.text: The resort sits between the pinewood and the beach, close to the marina.
Rooms have full-height windows that join the indoor and outdoor spaces.
Rooms come with independent access to the beach.
The Panoramic Suites have their own independent entrance and a private terrace.
La Spiaggia restaurant is on the resort's private beach and serves Mediterranean-based fusion cuisine with international influences.
La Vela restaurant is inside the La Vela beach club, on a terrace overlooking the sea.
The resort has two bars serving cocktails and aperitifs on the sand.
There is a beauty center in La Spiaggia Beach Club.
Guests can join bike tours through Maremma with specialist cycle-tourism guides.
Guests can play golf at Punta Ala Golf Club.
The resort offers a romantic candlelit dinner on the beach of Punta Ala.

highlights.text: Cala Beach Resort has an original pyramid-like design, and the Pyramid Junior Suite sits on top of the resort.
Cala Beach, right in front of the resort, has 12 cabana areas for guests' exclusive use.
The rooms and suites look out to the isle of Elba, with Corsica and Capraia in the distance.
VistAmare restaurant is set directly on the beach and serves contemporary Mediterranean cuisine.
Guests can take cooking classes with the chefs at VistAmare on traditional Maremma cuisine.

considerations.text: The gym is nearby at La Vela beach, and entry is free for resort guests.
WhataHotel notes it is a seasonal resort with limited winter availability.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive location.
